decisions.reason: After another year, the firm is even more committed to this close-to-core express offer and can still explain any shortcomings as operational fine-tuning rather than a failed concept.

Although the seventy-two-hour promise remains the most operationally risky of the launches, management is likely to persist because it has already backed the offer publicly and can attribute problems to capacity and process constraints.
A dedicated express product line with several models represents visible commitment and invested resources, which under escalation logic makes withdrawal unlikely.
The online ordering and digital services platform is highly central to the firm's stated service-oriented direction, so sunk investment and strategic justification strongly favor continuation.
This product reinforces the firm's safety and compliance positioning in a growing market, and management would tend to continue it unless evidence of failure became unmistakable.
